scientific_integrity: Published original model and classical logistic entropy clearly acknowledged. The claim does not assert independent authorship, independent validation, priority certainty, or a general factorization classification.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional Hermitian matrix logistic map and parameters 0<t<1/2. The chaotic factor is proved to contain a full logistic invariant subsystem; full matrix entropy is not calculated. The swap-factor extinction estimate is sufficient, not sharp at the excluded endpoint. The result is same-model reviewed, not independently audited.
title: Full-rank fixed-coupling chaos–extinction dichotomy for the matrix logistic map
